title: Learning a Rule Bank to Revise 3D CT Reports with Independent Evidence
abstract: arXiv:2611.28281v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision--language models can generate fluent radiology reports from 3D chest CT scans, yet they may still omit abnormalities or misstate findings. Independent image analysis using models separate from the report model provides additional observations, but acting on uncertain evidence may introduce new errors. We propose an agent system that learns a revision policy represented as an executable rule bank for each report model. Inspired by experience banks, the agent proposes and refines rules using revision outcomes across development cases. During inference, the retained rules guide local edits using independent classifier predictions and quantitative image measurements without retraining the report model. Unedited sentences are preserved, and each change is linked to the rule that triggered it. On CT-RATE, revision increases CE-F1 by 11.5 points for SelfCue-KD and 0.9 points for NV-Reason-CT, with gains across five draft-sampling seeds

translated_title: 学习规则库以利用独立证据修订3D CT报告
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言模型能够从3D胸部CT扫描生成流畅的放射学报告，但仍可能遗漏异常或错误陈述检查结果。使用与报告模型分离的模型进行独立图像分析可以提供额外的观察结果，但基于不确定证据采取行动可能引入新的错误。我们提出一个智能体系统，它学习一种修订策略，该策略被表示为每个报告模型的可执行规则库。受经验库的启发，该智能体利用开发案例中的修订结果来提出并改进规则。在推理阶段，保留的规则利用独立的分类器预测和定量图像测量来指导局部编辑，而无需重新训练报告模型。未经编辑的句子将被保留，并且每个更改都与触发它的规则相关联。在CT-RATE数据集上，修订使SelfCue-KD的CE-F1提高了11.5分，使NV-Reason-CT提高了0.9分，并且在五个草稿采样种子上均获得增益。
tldr: 提出一种智能体系统，通过学习可执行规则库，利用独立的分类器预测和定量图像测量来局部修订3D CT放射学报告，无需重新训练报告模型即可显著提升报告准确性，同时保留未编辑句子并将每处修改与触发规则关联。
en_tdlr: An agent system learns an executable rule bank that uses independent classifier predictions and quantitative image measurements to locally revise 3D CT radiology reports, significantly improving accuracy without retraining the report model, while preserving unedited sentences and linking each change to its triggering rule.
